lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob distance increasing along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary spot rows to form a subtle rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with light-colored dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A low-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots scattered across the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration of markers near the proximal base compared to the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal fish silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
